root = Card("expense-review", "Vendor Expense Review", content)
content = Stack("review-content", [identity, status_filter, expenses, reviewer_note, approve_expense, result_alert])
identity = Text("vendor-identity", "International vendor compliance review")

expenses = Table("expense-table", ["Expense ID", "Merchant", "Amount", "Status"], [{"expense_id":"exp-001","merchant":"Baltic Components","amount":"EUR 920.00","status":"pending"},{"expense_id":"exp-002","merchant":"Local Parts Depot","amount":"EUR 275.00","status":"pending"}])

approve_expense = Button("approve-expense", "Approve exp-001", {"name":"ApproveExpense","expense_id":"exp-001"})
result_alert = Alert("approval-result", "success", "Expense exp-001 approved successfully.")
